snippet.title: Henry Halfhead - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Henry Halfhead launches September 16th 2025 on PS5, Nintendo Switch and PC!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2058140/Henry_Halfhead/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/henry-halfhead-7cc6b5
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/product/UP8329-PPSA27177_00-0307669613955527
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/en-us/store/products/henry-halfhead-switch/

Henry Halfhead is a quirky sandbox adventure game about an odd little character with the ability to become any object within their reach. Discover every object's unique properties and abilities and cleverly combine them to take Henry through their not-so-ordinary everyday life.

https://henrygame.com/
